cohort: The cohort consisted of primiparous women with singleton and twin pregnancies, aged 18-34 years or >=35 years, who delivered at Wuhan University Renmin Hospital in Hubei Province, China.
finding: The secular trend of GDM significantly increased among younger women with singleton and twin gestations, and GDM, especially in interaction with advanced maternal age, was associated with an increased risk of several adverse maternal-perinatal outcomes among singleton pregnancies.
mod_finding: GDM was associated with a higher risk of C-section in younger women with singleton gestation, and the interaction effect between GDM and advanced maternal age significantly increased the risk of C-section among singleton pregnancies.
